Hi! This is Anwar. I'm trying my best to make some commissions about Blue Archive bondage and Damsel in Distress. To let more people see this, I decided to upload a version here as well. There might be some pictures I didn't share on Pixiv.

I’m not very fast at coming up with ideas, so updates may be slow. I like elegant and noble characters, and I’m also fond of well-tailored uniforms and formal dress. I’m not particularly interested in content involving blood, violence, filth, or unpleasant odors.

Here is my Pixiv page: https://www.pixiv.net/users/3456224

Hope you enjoy and feel free to leave comments!
